notes.title: Mini Update 5
notes.content:
[b]Mini Update 5 [/b]

[b]Improved Snapped Food Handling[/b] - You can now pick up the top food item in a snapped stack. Made a mistake while snapping ingredients together? No need to dump the whole burger, just grab the top layer and fix it. The lever to dump the burger is still available for when you're in a rush.

[b]Rebinding Reactivated [/b]- key rebinding is back! You can now easily remap your controls for both keyboard and controller from the settings menu.

[b]Achievements [/b]- 3 more achievements have been added.


[b]Let me know if you like the new changes and as always, feel free to share any feedback or suggestions. Thank you to everyone who's played Greed's Grub![/b]

notes.title: Mini Update 4
notes.content:
[b]Mini Update 4[/b]

- Simultaneous Controller & Keyboard Support: Both controller and keyboard inputs are now supported simultaneously. This change resolves an issue where the keyboard was sometimes incorrectly detected as a controller. As a result, key rebinding has been temporarily disabled to maintain input stability. It will be re-enabled in a future update. 

- Goblin Tutorial Slides : Added new tutorial slides to better explain Goblin mechanics for new and returning players.

- New Food Item: Bird Wings in endless mode.

Since the input system has been updated, sensitivity might feel slightly off. please let me know if you want changes so adjustments can be made.

[b]That's it for now! Let me know if you like the new changes and as always, feel free to share any feedback or suggestions. THANK YOU to everyone who's played Greed's Grub! [/b]

notes.title: Post-Update 3 Quick Patch
notes.content:
Quick Patch Notes:

- Third time's the charm? Tried another method to reduce frame drops. Let me know if it works!

- Fixed two minor in-game bugs noticed during testing.

notes.title: Mini Update 3
notes.content:
Mini Update 3 for Greed's Grub

[b]New Mode: Endless Mode[/b] - Try to feed the Man Baby as many orders as you can! Just keep going until you drop.

[b]Performance Optimizations [/b]- The game has been optimised again. Let me know if things are running smoother now or if you’re still seeing any frame drops.

[b]Temp Controller Detection Fix [/b]- If the game is detecting your setup as a controller by mistake, you can now switch to mouse & keyboard manually:
In Greed's Grub, go to Settings > Controls and press Switch.

[b]New Achievements [/b]- Two new achievements have been added! + Mini Easter eggs. More are on the way in future updates. 

[b]That's it for now, as always lemme know if u want any new changes.

Thank you to everyone who's played Greed's Grub![/b]

notes.title: Mini Update 2
notes.content:
[h1]Greed's Grub Changes:[/h1]

- If you fail a day, you normally start over from day one. I’ve kept that, but now you get one second chance during the 5 days and play a minigame. (Let me know if you like this change or if you'd prefer getting one second chance per day instead.)

- New slides in the tutorial.

- Game balance tweaks to all the days.

- Day 1 super quick and easy, and the goblin appears in Day 2 with tutorial slides for players.

- Buns moved, they are clearer and now labeled.

- Scenes are a bit brighter.  

[b]That's it for now, second mode should be in the next update.

Thank you to everyone who's played Greed's Grub![/b]
